description.value: Mountain Goodness is a locally owned health food store in Revelstoke that has operated since 2005, with current owner Heather Hood at the helm since 2019. The shop stocks certified organic groceries, fresh farm-direct produce from local Revelstoke-area growers, bulk refill staples, quality supplements, and natural bath and beauty products — all carefully vetted for quality and sustainability. Its small but well-curated format and knowledgeable staff make it a worthwhile resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through Revelstoke.
